title: Run payroll
summary: Process the regular monthly payroll run through Gusto.

parts.title: Check for employee changes
parts.guidance: Compare the employee roster with changes since the previous payroll: starters, departures, pay changes, work locations, leave and payment details. Match each change to its effective date and supporting instruction. Investigate unexpected differences with the people team, especially changes that could affect this run retrospectively. Give payroll a resolved change list and clearly separate requests still awaiting verification.

execution.rationale: Reconcile the supplied roster and effective-dated employee changes into a verified payroll input list.

parts.title: Verify time entries and PTO
parts.guidance: Reconcile hours and leave to the pay period and manager-approved entries. Look for missing time, overlaps, unusual overtime and corrections to earlier periods. Ask payroll how unresolved entries, unpaid leave and adjustments should be treated for the worker’s classification and location. Return specific discrepancies to the responsible manager, then use the corrected input set for the payroll preview.

execution.rationale: Reconcile supplied hours and leave with approved entries and identify exceptions for payroll and managers.

parts.title: Preview payroll summary
parts.guidance: Compare the payroll preview with the resolved input changes and previous run. Explain significant differences in headcount, gross pay, deductions, reimbursements, employer costs and net payments. Check unusual employee-level amounts as well as totals, then verify the funding account and required balance. Present the reconciled run and any remaining exceptions to the payroll approver before release.

execution.rationale: Gusto's payroll review screen exposes employee-level amounts and totals for comparison before release.

parts.title: Submit payroll
parts.guidance: Check that the run still matches the approved preview, employee population, pay date and funding account. Release that specific payroll under the company’s payment approval process. Check the submission result and processing warnings immediately. If status is uncertain or the request fails, investigate the existing run before retrying to avoid duplicate payments.

verify.how: Pay stubs generate for every employee and the provider confirms the federal and state tax deposits for the run — retain both artifacts.

execution.rationale: Gusto documents submitting the approved payroll and checking the resulting run status; approval remains required.

parts.title: Verify bank debit
parts.guidance: Match the provider’s funding record to the bank debit by run, amount and settlement details. Investigate missing, duplicate or different debits with payroll and the provider. Check employee-payment exceptions separately: the employer’s debit does not show that every employee received the intended amount. Close the reconciliation when funding and payment statuses agree, with any unresolved exception assigned for follow-up.

execution.rationale: Mercury records establish the bank debit. Closing the reconciliation also requires payroll funding and employee-payment exception statuses, whose retrieval method is not established here.

metadata.supportReason: Gusto API fully supports payroll. System verifies hours, checks for changes, previews, and submits with approval.
